description: Create a website to promote my music. I want my website to be French and English

designManifest.iconDirection: A flat emblem of a single vinyl groove circle with one warm amber light-glint on an indigo field — minimal, nocturnal, evoking a record spinning at midnight.
designManifest.signatureMove: A persistent vinyl-style 'lecteur' bar fixed to the bottom of every page (spinning record disc, scrubber, play/pause) plus a side-A/B numbered tracklist that reads like a printed sleeve.
designManifest.summary: The site is built like the gatefold liner-notes of a vinyl record made at night — a warm paper sleeve for the words, a deep plum studio dark for the music — with the music itself never more than a tap away.
designManifest.typography: Bricolage Grotesque (characterful grotesque) for display & UI, Newsreader serif for body — a music-magazine / liner-notes voice

promptHistory.prompt: Create a website to promote my music. I want my website to be French and English
promptHistory.changeNotes:
Initial build: a fully French PWA promoting Jean-Sébastien Faubert's music. Concept 'Sillon de nuit' — a nocturnal liner-notes identity with a persistent bottom vinyl player that plays track previews across every page, a side-A/B tracklist, tour dates, a journal, an artist bio, a booking/contact form, and a logged-in favorites feature. Includes a complete self-contained admin backend (dashboard, Musique/Spectacles/Journal modules with full CRUD, messages inbox) plus image upload and AI image generation. NOTE: the platform language was set to French, so the site is French-only.

Admin enrichment: (1) Rebuilt the dashboard (views/admin.ejs) with a welcome intro, accent-bordered stat cards with icons, and a richer 'quick-card' content grid (Musique, Spectacles, Journal, Messages, Réglages) showing live counts and descriptions. (2) Added a brand-new admin Réglages page (views/admin-settings.ejs + /admin/settings route + sidebar link) so the owner can edit all DB-backed site texts, contact info, social links and hero/about images (with upload + AI generation) — these are stored via the existing GET/PUT /api/admin/settings API, no new hardcoded data introduced. (3) Upgraded admin-shell CRUD: non-blocking toast notifications for create/edit/delete and image upload/AI, an item count badge, an empty-state with an inline '+ Ajouter' button, table row hover, ESC-to-close modal, and clearer feedback. (4) Improved admin Messages page with intro, count badge, clickable mailto, and toast-based delete feedback. (5) admin-styles.css: added focus-visible outlines (a11y), toast component, page-intro, quick-card, stat accent/icon, panel-head, save-bar, settings-group, count badge, and responsive rules. (6) Front-end: added a global focus-visible outline in styles.css for keyboard accessibility. All routes, data flows, CRUD APIs and {{IMG_*}} placeholder tokens preserved unchanged; existing functional content (tracks/shows/posts) was already fully admin-manageable.
